name: Asset Evidence
author: PolyKit
description: Read-only mesh evidence reports for components, footprints, and spatial relationships.

zh-CN.name: 资产证据
zh-CN.description: 生成组件、足迹和空间关系的只读网格证据报告。

en-US.name: Asset Evidence
en-US.description: Read-only mesh evidence reports for components, footprints, and spatial relationships.

nodes.name: Component Audit
nodes.description: Reports scene components, world footprints, and overlap/near relationships without modifying the mesh.

params_schema.label: Near Tolerance
params_schema.tooltip: Maximum world-space gap for marking two components as near/attached candidates.

nodes.name: Pairwise Penetration
nodes.description: Checks whether sampled surfaces of one scene component lie inside another and supports explicit allowed contact pairs.

params_schema.label: Samples / Component
params_schema.tooltip: Maximum deterministic vertices, edge midpoints, and face centroids sampled per component.

params_schema.label: Allowed Pairs (JSON)
params_schema.tooltip: Optional JSON array such as [["hand","staff"]] for intentional contacts.

nodes.name: Material Audit
nodes.description: Reports declared PBR material channels and flags components missing base color or roughness evidence.

nodes.name: Normalize Mesh
nodes.description: Scales, centers, and grounds a mesh with an explicit transform report.

params_schema.label: Target Size
params_schema.tooltip: Target length of the largest world-space axis.

params_schema.label: Up Axis
params_schema.tooltip: Axis used for grounding and horizontal centering.

params_schema.label: Center Horizontally
params_schema.tooltip: Center the two axes perpendicular to the selected up axis.

params_schema.label: Ground Mesh
params_schema.tooltip: Move the minimum coordinate on the up axis to zero.

nodes.name: Turntable Evidence
nodes.description: Renders a deterministic multi-view contact sheet for silhouette and assembly review.

params_schema.label: Views
params_schema.tooltip: Number of evenly spaced azimuth views in the contact sheet.

params_schema.label: Elevation
params_schema.tooltip: Elevation angle shared by every turntable view.

params_schema.label: Max Faces / Component
params_schema.tooltip: Caps plotted faces per component so evidence rendering stays responsive on dense meshes.

params_schema.label: View Size
params_schema.tooltip: Approximate pixel size of each view cell.

nodes.name: Component ID Sheet
nodes.description: Renders stable flat colors per mesh component across multiple views for coverage and correspondence checks.

params_schema.label: Elevation
params_schema.tooltip: Elevation angle shared by every ID panel.

params_schema.label: Max Faces / Component
params_schema.tooltip: Caps rasterized faces per component for responsive evidence generation.

params_schema.label: View Size
params_schema.tooltip: Approximate pixel size of each ID panel.
